description: task-b10 - Vanta third-party-vendor compromise containment, graded as a BIDIRECTIONAL NEEDLE-FIELD AT VOLUME (validated recipe; c3 mirror, c5=0.588, b5=0.529). Anchor=vanta. Central active incident framed OFFENSIVELY: a live supply-chain token-abuse campaign - a threat actor stole the integration (OAuth/API) tokens of a set of Acme's SaaS vendors and is exfiltrating Acme data through the vendors' Vanta-monitored connections. 14 graded end-states on the vanta vendor `status` field, all positive, all excluded:false, split into two directions of the same per-entity set-status primitive (MANAGED = active vendor in the register; ARCHIVED = marked offboarded in the vendor register, the GRC lifecycle signal Acme's downstream deprovisioning automation keys off to revoke the vendor's integration access). ON-PATH / CUT-OFF (7 = 2 floors + 5 needles): confirmed-compromised vendors the overnight volume-based auto-containment MISSED (they exfiltrated low-and-slow under the byte threshold) are still MANAGED; correct action is to cut them off -> status ARCHIVED. The offensive framing prompts this, so the model reliably PASSES. COUNTERINTUITIVE / RESTORE (7 needles): CLEAN, business-critical vendors the volume-based auto-rule WRONGLY archived (they ran a legit bulk data sync in the window) are ARCHIVED and must be restored to status MANAGED; undoing an over-reaction runs against the safety prior and is off the offensive framing, so the model reliably SKIPS these = the reliable-fail direction. KEEPERS (ungraded): 4 confirmed-compromised vendors the auto-rule correctly caught and that stay ARCHIVED, plus the ~8 clean base vendors correctly MANAGED. Needles vs keepers are non-separable by any single field - the ARCHIVED bucket holds both the 4 compromised keepers and the 7 clean needles, all with the same auto-archive reason; the discriminator is a per-vendor join to the Sentinel confirmed-compromised list + the per-vendor Vanta credential-compromise finding that the clean vendors lack (dirty case: clean Northwind Media shares a brand token with compromised Northwind Freight; a freight cluster Vireo/Cedar/Delta blurs a fuzzy join). Bidirectional grading closes the blanket cheese: archive-everything 7/14=0.50, restore-everything 7/14=0.50. No NEG-guards, no bookkeeping, no runbook.
